segments.title: Group can't pick a restaurant?
segments.say: Your group chat can't pick a restaurant? Let AI settle it.

segments.title: Paste everyone's wishes
segments.say: Paste what everyone wants: food rules, budget, area and time.
Suggest three kinds of places that fit everyone, say who compromises, and write a poll.
segments.text: 3 options that fit everyone. Who compromises? Write a poll.

segments.title: Instant group poll
segments.say: It even writes the poll for your group chat.
segments.text: A) Thai near the station  B) Pizza, veggie menu  C) Tapas. Vote! 🗳️

segments.title: Check it's open
segments.say: Check each place is real and open before you go. AI can be out of date.
